title: Get, renew or revoke a Creator access token
content_data:
- To get or renew the short-term Creator access token, you can use /tt_user/oauth2/token/ and /tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/ respectively. - The `/tt_user/oauth2/token/` endpoint now requires `redirect_uri` for better security. The short-term Creator access token remains valid for 24 hours, whereas the Creator refresh token remains valid for a year. You can get the access token using `/tt_user/oauth2/token/` and refresh it daily with the refresh token via `/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/` within one year. However, after one year, you need the creator to reauthorize it. - To revoke a Creator access token, use /tt_user/oauth2/revoke/. # Obtain a Creator access token Use this endpoint to get a Creator access token. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |client_id{required}|string|ID of your developer app.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| |client_secret{required}|string| Secret of your developer app.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | grant_type {Required} | string | The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:
  • `authorization_code`: To generate the access token by authorization code.
| | auth_code {Required} | string | The authorization code (`auth_code`) generated by your TikTok account holder authorization URL.

The code is valid for 10 minutes and can only be used once.

To find out how to get the authorization code based on the type of API you use, see the "Authorization URL" row in [Comparing authorization for different APIs](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1781891256601602#item-link-Comparing%20authorization%20for%20different%20APIs). | | redirect_uri {Required} | string | The redirect URL which the client will be directed to.

Its value must be the same as the TikTok account holder redirect URL set in the app. | ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id|string| The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|access_token | string | The short-term token for permission verification.

The token expires in one day. | #|token_type | string | The type of token.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope | string | The scope of permissions granted to the access token. | #|expires_in | number | The time remaining until the access token expires, measured in seconds. | #|refresh_token | string | The refresh token, which can be used to renew the access token.

The refresh token is valid for one year.

Note: Retain this field for `access_token` renewal. | #|refresh_token_expires_in | number | The time remaining until the refresh token expires, measured in seconds. | #|open_id | string | Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account. | ``` # Renew a Creator access token Use this endpoint to renew a Creator access token by `refresh_token`. ## Request **Endpoint** **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |client_id{required}|string|ID of your developer app.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| |client_secret{required}|string|Secret of your developer app.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |grant_type{required}|string|The way of generating the access token.

The allowed enum value:

  • `refresh_token`: To generate the access token by refresh token.
| |refresh_token{required}|string|Refresh token to renew an existing access token.

You can obtain the refresh token in the response of /tt_user/oauth2/token/ endpoint when you generate an access token.| ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data|object|Returned data.| #|access_token | string | The short-term token for permission verification.

The token expires in one day. | #|token_type | string | The type of token.

Enum value:
  • `Bearer`: Bearer token. Anyone in possession of the token can use it to access the associated resources.
| #|scope | string | The scope of permissions granted to the access token. | #|expires_in | number | The time remaining until the access token expires, measured in seconds. | #|refresh_token | string | The refresh token, which can be used to renew the access token.

The refresh token is valid for one year.

Note: Retain this field for `access_token` renewal. | #|refresh_token_expires_in | number | The time remaining until the refresh token expires, measured in seconds. | #|open_id | string | Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account. | ``` # Revoke a Creator access token Use this endpoint to revoke a Creator access token. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/revoke/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | client_id {Required} | string | ID of your developer application.

To find the App ID, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | client_secret {Required} | string | Secret of your developer application.

To find the Secret, navigate to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | | access_token {Required} | string | The Creator access token that you want to revoke.

You can either create a new access token via /tt_user/oauth2/token/ or obtain a renewed access token via /tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/ . | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tt_user/oauth2/revoke/' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "client_id":"{{client_id}}", "client_secret":"{{client_secret}}", "access_token":"{{access_token}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": {} } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get, renew or revoke a TikTok Creator access token via API
seo_description: Use these endpoints to get, renew or revoke a Creator access token. Integrating with the correct endpoint helps you get the task done right.
